title: Trust configuration (SPEC §12)
description: LOCAL VERIFIER CONFIGURATION, NOT PROTOCOL STATE. Unsigned, never hashed into a WarrantID, never authority on its own. Closed member set: an unknown member makes the configuration invalid, and a settlement verification REQUESTED with an invalid one MUST fail closed with exactly one ERR whose subject is "settlement" (§12.3) — a rule this schema cannot express. {} is valid and means "no local trust".

actors.description: actor id -> genesis-bound Ed25519 public keys. Key state itself derives from key-state warrants (§5.1); this pins only where that derivation starts.

genesis_roots.description: §9(1): WarrantIDs of roots the operator pins as settlement-active for this store.

genesis_json_sha256.description: §9: SHA-256 of the exact genesis.json bytes the operator accepted. Without a match, genesis.json is WARN: genesis.json unverified and its contents MUST NOT be used.
